examples.chinese: 我下午有課，中午不回家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiàwǔ yǒu kè, zhōngwǔ bù huí jiā.
examples.english: I have class in the afternoon; I am not coming home at noon.

examples.chinese: 我跟媽媽明天下午要一起去看電影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn māma míngtiān xiàwǔ yào yìqǐ qù kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: Mom and I are going to see a movie tomorrow afternoon.

examples.chinese: 前天下午我在學校的圖書館看書。
examples.pinyin: Qiántiān xiàwǔ wǒ zài xuéxiào de túshūguǎn kànshū.
examples.english: I read at the school library in the afternoon of the day before yesterday.

examples.chinese: 今天下午學校有籃球比賽，我們去看吧！
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ xuéxiào yǒu lánqiú bǐsài, wǒmen qù kàn ba!
examples.english: There is a basketball game at school this afternoon. Let’s go watch it!

examples.chinese: 妳星期六下午有空嗎？我們一起去喝下午茶，怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xīngqí liù xiàwǔ yǒukòng ma? Wǒmen yìqǐ qù hē xiàwǔ chá, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: Are you available on Saturday afternoon? How about we have afternoon tea together?

examples.chinese: 我們這個星期六下午兩點半去吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhè ge xīngqí liù xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn bàn qù ba.
examples.english: Let’s go this Saturday at 2:30 p.m.

examples.chinese: 媽，我跟友美要去喝下午茶，可是我的錢包不在房間裡。
examples.pinyin: Mā, wǒ gēn Yǒuměi yào qù hē xiàwǔ chá, kěshì wǒ de qiánbāo bú zài fángjiān lǐ.
examples.english: Mom, Youmei and I are going to have afternoon tea now, but my wallet is not in the bedroom.

examples.chinese: 我們下午四點要到天美飯店，她在那裡等我們。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ sì diǎn yào dào Tiānměi Fàndiàn, tā zài nàli děng wǒmen.
examples.english: We have to arrive at Tianmei Hotel at 4 in the afternoon. She will wait for us there.

examples.chinese: 我們班只能禮拜一跟禮拜二下午用。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bān zhǐ néng lǐbài yī gēn lǐbài èr xiàwǔ yòng.
examples.english: Our class can only use it in the afternoon on Mondays and Tuesdays.

examples.chinese: 這個學期開始，從星期一到星期五我都有華語課，每天從上午八點四十分到中午十二點上課，下午一點寫功課，有時候也跟同學練習說中文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí kāishǐ, cóng xīngqí yī dào xīngqí wǔ, wǒ dōu yǒu Huáyǔ kè, měi tiān cóng shàngwǔ bā diǎn sìshí fēn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn shàngkè, xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiě gōngkè, yǒushíhou yě gēn tóngxué liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
examples.english: This semester I have Chinese class from 8:40 a.m. to 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. I start to do my homework at 1:00 p.m., and sometimes I practice speaking Chinese with my classmates.

items.wordHook: 下(down) + 午(noon) → the time after noon, afternoon.

examples.chinese: 宜文昨天幾點睡覺？
examples.pinyin: Yíwén zuótiān jǐ diǎn shuìjiào?
examples.english: What time did Yiwen go to sleep yesterday?

examples.chinese: 可是我只想聽音樂、睡覺。
examples.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ zhǐ xiǎng tīng yīnyuè, shuìjiào.
examples.english: But I only want to listen to music and sleep.

items.wordHook: You 睡(sleep) until 覺(conscious) comes back → 睡覺(to sleep; to go to bed).

examples.chinese: 我會給你三天的藥。你要記得多喝一點兒水，要是發燒了，就吃紅色的藥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì gěi nǐ sān tiān de yào. Nǐ yào jìde duō hē yìdiǎnr shuǐ, yàoshi fāshāo le, jiù chī hóngsè de yào.
examples.english: I will give you medicine for 3 days. Remember to drink plenty of water. If you have a fever, then take the red pill.

examples.chinese: 今天我要帶一些水果去看他，也會跟他說今天的功課。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ yào dài yìxiē shuǐguǒ qù kàn tā, yě huì gēn tā shuō jīntiān de gōngkè.
examples.english: Today, I am going to take some fruit to visit him and also inform him about the homework today.

examples.chinese: 他說他會去看醫生，請我們不要擔心，如果他好了，就會來學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō tā huì qù kàn yīshēng, qǐng wǒmen bú yào dānxīn, rúguǒ tā hǎo le, jiù huì lái xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: He said he will go see a doctor and he does not want to worry us. If he feels better, he will come to school.

examples.chinese: 他會唱很多首中文歌。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì chàng hěn duō shǒu Zhōngwén gē.
examples.english: He can sing a lot of Chinese songs.

examples.chinese: 我不會游泳，你會嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú huì yóuyǒng, nǐ huì ma?
examples.english: I can not swim, can you?

examples.chinese: 我不會游泳。宜文，妳會游泳嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú huì yóuyǒng. Yíwén, nǐ huì yóuyǒng ma?
examples.english: I can not swim. Yiwen, can you swim?

examples.chinese: 我會游泳，可是游得不太好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì yóuyǒng, kěshì yóu de bú tài hǎo.
examples.english: I can swim, but not very well.

examples.chinese: 這個星期六是元宵節，妳跟友美會去看燈會嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xīngqī liù shì Yuánxiāojié, nǐ gēn Yǒuměi huì qù kàn dēnghuì ma?
examples.english: This Saturday is the Lantern Festival. Will you and Youmei go to see the Lantern Carnival?

examples.chinese: 友美說她想去，我還沒決定去不去。燈會好玩嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi shuō tā xiǎng qù, wǒ háiméi juédìng qù bú qù. Dēnghuì hǎowán ma?
examples.english: Youmei wants to see it. But I haven’t decided to go. Is the Lantern Carnival fun?

examples.chinese: 我去年去看了，很多大人帶著小孩去看燈會，非常熱鬧，我照了很多相片。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qùnián qù kàn le, hěn duō dàrén dài zhe xiǎohái qù kàn dēnghuì, fēicháng rènào, wǒ zhào le hěn duō xiàngpiàn.
examples.english: Last year I went to see the Carnival. Many adults brought their children to see the Lantern Carnival, and it was very lively. I took a lot of photos.

examples.chinese: 我週末還要工作，打算一下班就去看燈會。我們可以約友美一起去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhōumò hái yào gōngzuò, dǎsuàn yí xiàbān jiù qù kàn dēnghuì. Wǒmen kěyǐ yuē Yǒuměi yìqǐ qù.
examples.english: I have to work on weekends, and plan to go to the Lantern Carnival as soon as I get off from work. We can ask Youmei out for the Lantern Carnival together.

items.wordHook: a 亼(gather) of people inside a 囗(box) under a ⺌(small) 日(sun) → 會(assemble).

examples.chinese: 聽說這家工廠的工人都很辛苦，可是老闆給的錢不多。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè jiā gōngchǎng de gōngrén dōu hěn xīnkǔ, kěshì lǎobǎn gěi de qián bù duō.
examples.english: I heard that the workers at this factory all work very hard, but the money the boss gives is not much.

examples.chinese: 老闆今天帶我去參觀了一家工廠。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn jīntiān dài wǒ qù cānguān le yì jiā gōngchǎng.
examples.english: The boss took me to visit a factory today.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠的工作很辛苦，可是錢很多，所以很多人願意做。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng de gōngzuò hěn xīnkǔ, kěshì qián hěn duō, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén yuànyì zuò.
examples.english: The work at that factory is very hard, but the pay is good, so many people are willing to do it.

examples.chinese: A:你怎麼了？看起來很不開心的樣子。 B:唉！工廠發生問題，今天又得加班處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme le? Kàn qǐlái hěn bù kāixīn de yàngzi. B: Āi! Gōngchǎng fāshēng wèntí, jīntiān yòu děi jiābān chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: What's wrong? You look very unhappy. B: Alas! There's a problem at the factory; I have to work overtime again today to deal with it.

examples.chinese: 小龍受不了在那個又熱又髒的工廠工作，只做了三天就離開了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎolóng shòubuliǎo zài nàge yòu rè yòu zāng de gōngchǎng gōngzuò, zhǐ zuò le sān tiān jiù líkāi le.
examples.english: Xiaolong could not bear to work in that hot and dirty factory; he only worked for three days and then left.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠生產的皮鞋、皮帶，不但品質好，價錢也不貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng shēngchǎn de píxié, pídài, bùdàn pǐnzhí hǎo, jiàqián yě bù guì.
examples.english: The leather shoes and belts that that factory produces are not only good in quality, but also not expensive in price.

examples.chinese: 這次的水災不僅淹了整條街，好幾家工廠也因為淹水沒辦法生產，真是太糟了！
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de shuǐzāi bùjǐn yān le zhěng tiáo jiē, hǎo jǐ jiā gōngchǎng yě yīnwèi yānshuǐ méi bànfǎ shēngchǎn, zhēn shì tài zāo le!
examples.english: This flooding not only flooded the entire street, but several factories also couldn't produce because of the flooding—it's really too bad!

examples.chinese: 那個工人使用工廠的機器時，不小心發生了意外，流了很多血。
examples.pinyin: Nàge gōngrén shǐyòng gōngchǎng de jīqì shí, bù xiǎoxīn fāshēng le yìwài, liú le hěn duō xiě.
examples.english: When that worker was using the factory machine, an accident happened accidentally, and he bled a lot.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠自從改善了設備以後，生產速度就一天比一天快了。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng zìcóng gǎishàn le shèbèi yǐhòu, shēngchǎn sùdù jiù yī tiān bǐ yī tiān kuài le.
examples.english: Ever since that factory improved its equipment, its production speed has become faster day by day.

examples.chinese: 今天客人跟著小溫去參觀工廠，也試用了新產品，一切安排都令他十分滿意。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kèrén gēnzhe Xiǎo Wēn qù cānguān gōngchǎng, yě shìyòng le xīn chǎnpǐn, yīqiè ānpái dōu lìng tā shífēn mǎnyì.
examples.english: Today the guests followed Xiao Wen to visit the factory and also tried out new products; all the arrangements made him very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠的設備及員工都嚴重缺乏，哪裡有辦法進一步發展？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng de shèbèi jí yuángōng dōu yánzhòng quēfá, nǎlǐ yǒu bànfǎ jìnyībù fāzhǎn?
examples.english: That factory is severely lacking in both equipment and employees; how could there be any way to develop further?

examples.chinese: 家中的廢車可送到汽車修理工廠回收，多多少少能賣點錢。
examples.pinyin: Jiā zhōng de fèichē kě sòng dào qìchē xiūlǐ gōngchǎng huíshōu, duōduōshǎoshǎo néng mài diǎn qián.
examples.english: The derelict car at home can be sent to an auto repair shop for recycling; you can more or less sell it for some money.

examples.chinese: 工廠排水系統得設計好，以免汙染自然環境。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchǎng pái shuǐ xìtǒng děi shèjì hǎo, yǐmiǎn wūrǎn zìrán huánjìng.
examples.english: The factory's drainage system must be well designed, lest it pollute the natural environment.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠排出的廢氣很毒，附近已經有不少民眾生病了。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng pái chū de fèiqì hěn dú, fùjìn yǐjīng yǒu bùshǎo mínzhòng shēngbìng le.
examples.english: The exhaust fumes emitted by that factory are very poisonous; many people nearby have already gotten sick.

examples.chinese: 我們工廠與那家旅行社有合作關係，廠內員工如果報名他們的旅行團，都可以享受優惠價。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngchǎng yǔ nà jiā lǚxíngshè yǒu hézuò guānxì, chǎng nèi yuángōng rúguǒ bàomíng tāmen de lǚxíngtuán, dōu kěyǐ xiǎngshòu yōuhuì jià.
examples.english: Our factory has a partnership with that travel agency; if employees sign up for their tour group, they can all enjoy a discounted price.

examples.chinese: 你既然把工廠交給他，就得放手讓他去管理。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jìrán bǎ gōngchǎng jiāo gěi tā, jiù děi fàngshǒu ràng tā qù guǎnlǐ.
examples.english: Since you've handed the factory over to him, you must let go and let him manage it.

examples.chinese: 新員工在經過專門的訓練後，都已能使用工廠各種生產機器。
examples.pinyin: Xīn yuángōng zài jīngguò zhuānmén de xùnliàn hòu, dōu yǐ néng shǐyòng gōngchǎng gè zhǒng shēngchǎn jīqì.
examples.english: After receiving specialized training, the new employees are all now able to use the various production machines in the factory.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠排出的黑煙不只氣味難聞，更可怕的是可能對肺部造成傷害。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng pái chū de hēiyān bùzhǐ qìwèi nánwén, gèng kěpà de shì kěnéng duì fèibù zàochéng shānghài.
examples.english: The black smoke emitted by that factory not only smells bad, but even more frighteningly, it may cause harm to the lungs.

examples.chinese: 我們特地到當地的滑雪用品工廠參觀，並進行技術交流。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen tèdì dào dāngdì de huáxuě yòngpǐn gōngchǎng cānguān, bìng jìnxíng jìshù jiāoliú.
examples.english: We specially visited a local ski equipment factory and conducted technical exchanges.

examples.chinese: 自動化工廠不僅使生產速度更快，同時也能保證產品品質。
examples.pinyin: Zìdònghuà gōngchǎng bùjǐn shǐ shēngchǎn sùdù gèng kuài, tóngshí yě néng bǎozhèng chǎnpǐn pǐnzhí.
examples.english: Automated factories not only make production speed faster but also can guarantee product quality.

examples.chinese: 這家工廠使用的大型機械全都是淺綠色的，看起來很有特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng shǐyòng de dàxíng jīxiè quán dōu shì qiǎnlǜsè de, kàn qǐlái hěn yǒu tèsè.
examples.english: The large machinery used in this factory is all light green, and looks very distinctive.

examples.chinese: 她在電子工廠上班，難怪拆機器的技術非常熟練。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài diànzǐ gōngchǎng shàngbān, nánguài chāi jīqì de jìshù fēicháng shúliàn.
examples.english: She works at an electronics factory, no wonder her skill in disassembling machines is very proficient.

examples.chinese: 臺灣企業到發展中國家設立工廠，是因為當地的人工便宜。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān qǐyè dào fāzhǎnzhōng guójiā shèlì gōngchǎng, shì yīnwèi dāngdì de réngōng piányi.
examples.english: Taiwanese enterprises set up factories in developing countries because local labor is cheap.

examples.chinese: 在抗議新建工廠的活動中，當地的環保團體聯合起來表達他們的需求。
examples.pinyin: Zài kàngyì xīn jiàn gōngchǎng de huódòng zhōng, dāngdì de huánbǎo tuántǐ liánhé qǐlái biǎodá tāmen de xūqiú.
examples.english: In the protest against the construction of a new factory, local environmental groups united to express their demands.

examples.chinese: 這家工廠奪下了著名品牌產品的製造機會。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng duó xià le zhùmíng pǐnpái chǎnpǐn de zhìzào jīhuì.
examples.english: This factory seized the manufacturing opportunity for a famous brand's products.

items.wordHook: 工(labor) + 廠(factory) → a place of labor: 工廠(factory).

examples.chinese: 夜市裡有各種小吃和飲料。
examples.pinyin: Yèshì lǐ yǒu gè zhǒng xiǎochī hé yǐnliào.
examples.english: In the night market, there are various kinds of snacks and drinks.

examples.chinese: 台灣的夜市很有特色，除了有各式各樣的小吃，還有不少好玩的遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de yèshì hěn yǒu tèsè, chúle yǒu gèshìgèyàng de xiǎochī, hái yǒu bùshǎo hǎowán de yóuxì.
examples.english: Taiwan's night markets are very distinctive; besides having various snacks, there are also quite a few fun games.

examples.chinese: 台灣有各式各樣的小吃，其中最吸引我的是蚵仔煎。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yǒu gèshìgèyàng de xiǎochī, qízhōng zuì xīyǐn wǒ de shì kēzǎijiān.
examples.english: Taiwan has all kinds of snacks, among which the one that attracts me most is oyster omelet.

examples.chinese: 公司進了各式各樣的健身機器， 我們得好好利用這些機器，訓練自己的體力。美美剛進模特兒公司時，有一位導演找她演戲，沒想到就讓她變成了有名的明星。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jìn le gèshì-gèyàng de jiànshēn jīqì, wǒmen děi hǎohǎo lìyòng zhèxiē jīqì, xùnliàn zìjǐ de tǐlì. Měiměi gāng jìn mótè'ér gōngsī shí, yǒu yí wèi dǎoyǎn zhǎo tā yǎn xì, méi xiǎngdào jiù ràng tā biàn chéng le yǒumíng de míngxīng.
examples.english: The company purchased various kinds of fitness machines; we must make good use of these machines to train our physical strength. When Meimei first entered the modeling agency, a director asked her to act in a show; unexpectedly, it made her a famous star.

examples.chinese: 這次的電腦展集合了各國有名的牌子，很值得參觀。老師要帶我們去參觀博物館，明天早上九點在校門口集合。
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhè cì de diànnǎo zhǎn jíhé le gè guó yǒumíng de páizi, hěn zhídé cānguān. 2. Lǎoshī yào dài wǒmen qù cānguān bówùguǎn, míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn zài xiàoménkǒu jíhé.
examples.english: 1. This computer exhibition gathered famous brands from various countries and is well worth visiting. 2. The teacher is taking us to visit the museum; we will gather at the school gate at 9 a.m. tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 春天來了，天氣變暖和了，院子裡開了各種顏色的花，給人帶來一種新的希望。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān lái le, tiānqì biàn nuǎnhuo le, yuànzi lǐ kāi le gè zhǒng yánsè de huā, gěi rén dàilái yī zhǒng xīn de xīwàng.
examples.english: Spring has come, the weather has become warmer, and flowers of various colors have blossomed in the yard, bringing people a new kind of hope.

examples.chinese: 臺灣南部不僅天氣好、旅遊景點多，還有各式各樣的傳統小吃，很值得去走走。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān nánbù bùjǐn tiānqì hǎo, lǚyóu jǐngdiǎn duō, hái yǒu gè shì gè yàng de chuántǒng xiǎochī, hěn zhídé qù zǒuzǒu.
examples.english: Southern Taiwan not only has good weather and many touring spots, but also has all kinds of traditional snacks; it's well worth a visit.

examples.chinese: 這次地震的規模很大，連總統一時也很難掌握各地的災情。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì dìzhèn de guīmó hěn dà, lián zǒngtǒng yīshí yě hěn nán zhǎngwò gèdì de zāiqíng.
examples.english: The scale of this earthquake was very large; even the president had difficulty grasping the disaster situation in various places for a while.

examples.chinese: 這堂課的內容跟文化有關，所以老師把教學重心放在介紹各國的文化特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng kè de nèiróng gēn wénhuà yǒuguān, suǒyǐ lǎoshī bǎ jiàoxué zhòngxīn fàng zài jièshào gè guó de wénhuà tèsè.
examples.english: The content of this class is related to culture, so the teacher put the teaching focus on introducing the cultural characteristics of various countries.

examples.chinese: 這個教材比較難，老師怕學生不容易吸收，因此利用各種教學工具來幫助學生學習。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiàocái bǐjiào nán, lǎoshī pà xuéshēng bù róngyì xīshōu, yīncǐ lìyòng gè zhǒng jiàoxué gōngjù lái bāngzhù xuéshēng xuéxí.
examples.english: This textbook is rather difficult; the teacher was afraid students wouldn't easily absorb it, therefore used various teaching tools to help students learn.

examples.chinese: 明天要考五科，每科的測驗題目各有五十題，我想今天晚上得開夜車了。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yào kǎo wǔ kē, měi kē de cèyàn tímù gè yǒu wǔshí tí, wǒ xiǎng jīntiān wǎnshang děi kāi yèchē le.
examples.english: Tomorrow I have exams in five subjects; each subject has fifty test questions, so I think tonight I'll have to burn the midnight oil.

examples.chinese: 現代各式各樣的科技產品，讓人們的生活更舒適、便利。這家旅館每個房間都設計得很現代，吸引不少年輕人來訂房。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài gè shì gè yàng de kējì chǎnpǐn, ràng rénmen de shēnghuó gèng shūshì, biànlì. Zhè jiā lǚguǎn měi gè fángjiān dōu shèjì de hěn xiàndài, xīyǐn bù shǎo niánqīngrén lái dìng fáng.
examples.english: Modern various technological products make people's lives more comfortable and convenient. This hotel's rooms are all designed in a very modern way, attracting many young people to book rooms.

examples.chinese: 這次亞洲文化展，除了樂器表演，還有傳統服裝試穿活動，歡迎各位來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì Yàzhōu wénhuà zhǎn, chúle yuèqì biǎoyǎn, hái yǒu chuántǒng fúzhuāng shìchuān huódòng, huānyíng gèwèi lái cānguān.
examples.english: This Asian Culture Exhibition, in addition to musical instrument performances, also has traditional clothing try-on activities; everyone is welcome to visit.

examples.chinese: 公司的會議資料都存在雲端，這樣又安全又方便，各部門也能隨時參考。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de huìyì zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, zhèyàng yòu ānquán yòu fāngbiàn, gè bùmén yě néng suíshí cānkǎo.
examples.english: The company's meeting materials are all stored in the cloud; this way it is both safe and convenient, and each department can also refer to them at any time.

examples.chinese: 明天的會議資料我已經上傳到雲端，請各位開會前先了解要討論的內容。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de huìyì zīliào wǒ yǐjīng shàngchuán dào yúnduān, qǐng gèwèi kāihuì qián xiān liǎojiě yào tǎolùn de nèiróng.
examples.english: I have already uploaded tomorrow's meeting materials to the cloud; please understand the content to be discussed before the meeting.

examples.chinese: 史教授為了讓更多人了解保護地球環境有多重要，經常到各地去演講。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ jiàoshòu wèi le ràng gèng duō rén liǎojiě bǎohù dìqiú huánjìng yǒu duō zhòngyào, jīngcháng dào gèdì qù yǎnjiǎng.
examples.english: In order to let more people understand how important it is to protect the Earth's environment, Professor Shi often goes to various places to give speeches.

examples.chinese: 網路商店滿足了人們購物的需求，就是不出門，也可買到各式各樣的生活用品。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn mǎnzú le rénmen gòuwù de xūqiú, jiùshì bù chūmén, yě kě mǎi dào gè shì gè yàng de shēnghuó yòngpǐn.
examples.english: Online stores have satisfied people's shopping needs; even without leaving home, you can buy all kinds of daily necessities.

examples.chinese: 為了使市區（shìqū， urban area）的交通更便利，目前黃市長正進行各種改善計畫。
examples.pinyin: Wèile shǐ shìqū de jiāotōng gèng biànlì, mùqián Huáng shìzhǎng zhèng jìnxíng gè zhǒng gǎishàn jìhuà.
examples.english: In order to make traffic in the urban area more convenient, right now Mayor Huang is proceeding with various improvement plans.

examples.chinese: 科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí. Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english: Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life. The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 快時尚的概念，就是在短時間內提供各式各樣的流行商品，讓顧客有更多更好的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Kuài shíshàng de gàiniàn, jiùshì zài duǎn shíjiān nèi tígōng gè shì gè yàng de liúxíng shāngpǐn, ràng gùkè yǒu gèng duō gèng hǎo de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The concept of fast fashion is to provide a variety of trendy products in a short time, giving customers more and better choices.

examples.chinese: 元宵節時公園裡點起各式各樣的燈籠，各種顏色的燈光漂亮極了。
examples.pinyin: Yuánxiāojié shí gōngyuán lǐ diǎn qǐ gè shì gè yàng de dēnglóng, gè zhǒng yánsè de dēngguāng piàoliang jí le.
examples.english: During the Lantern Festival, various lanterns are lit in the park; the lights of all colors are extremely beautiful.

examples.chinese: 叔叔時常跟我聊他到世界各地旅行的故事，真是有意思。
examples.pinyin: Shūshu shícháng gēn wǒ liáo tā dào shìjiè gèdì lǚxíng de gùshì, zhēn shì yǒu yìsi.
examples.english: My uncle often chats with me about his stories of traveling around the world; it's really interesting.

examples.chinese: 我心中有兩個夢想，一是當歌星，另一個是去各國旅行。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xīn zhōng yǒu liǎng ge mèngxiǎng, yī shì dāng gēxīng, lìng yí ge shì qù gè guó lǚxíng.
examples.english: I have two dreams in my heart: one is to become a singer, and the other is to travel to various countries.

examples.chinese: 那輛腳踏車對個子小的我來說太高了，腳很難跨過去。我們大學前年起已開放跨校選課，增加各校的交流機會。
examples.pinyin: Nà liàng jiǎotàchē duì gèzi xiǎo de wǒ lái shuō tài gāo le, jiǎo hěn nán kuà guòqù. Wǒmen dàxué qiánnián qǐ yǐ kāifàng kuàxiào xuǎnkè, zēngjiā gè xiào de jiāoliú jīhuì.
examples.english: That bicycle is too high for me, since I'm short, so it's hard to straddle my leg over it. Our university has offered cross-school course selection since the year before last, increasing opportunities for exchange between schools.

examples.chinese: 註了冊以後，新生要把相關證件各影印一份，交給學校。
examples.pinyin: Zhù le cè yǐhòu, xīnshēng yào bǎ xiāngguān zhèngjiàn gè yǐngyìn yī fèn, jiāo gěi xuéxiào.
examples.english: After registering, new students must photocopy one copy of each relevant document and submit them to the school.

examples.chinese: 根據車禍調查的結果，保險公司及對方應各賠我十萬元。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù chēhuò diàochá de jiéguǒ, bǎoxiǎn gōngsī jí duìfāng yīng gè péi wǒ shí wàn yuán.
examples.english: According to the results of the car accident investigation, the insurance company and the other party should each compensate me one hundred thousand dollars.

examples.chinese: 在歐洲，小麥做的各種食品常被當作餐桌上的主要食物。
examples.pinyin: Zài Ōuzhōu, xiǎomài zuò de gè zhǒng shípǐn cháng bèi dàngzuò cānzhuō shàng de zhǔyào shíwù.
examples.english: In Europe, various foods made from wheat are often regarded as the main food on the dining table.

examples.chinese: 地球氣溫越來越高，世界各地氣候的變化也越來越明顯。
examples.pinyin: Dìqiú qìwēn yuè lái yuè gāo, shìjiè gèdì qìhòu de biànhuà yě yuè lái yuè míngxiǎn.
examples.english: The Earth’s temperature is getting higher and higher, and climate changes around the world are also becoming more and more obvious.

examples.chinese: 教授的房間堆滿了各種書籍，本來就不大的房間感覺更擠了。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu de fángjiān duī mǎn le gè zhǒng shūjí, běnlái jiù bù dà de fángjiān gǎnjué gèng jǐ le.
examples.english: The professor's room is piled full of all kinds of books; the room, which wasn't big to begin with, feels even more crowded.

examples.chinese: 政府最主要的任務應是維持並保護社會安全，其次是規畫各種制度，使國家穩定地成長。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zuì zhǔyào de rènwu yīng shì wéichí bìng bǎohù shèhuì ānquán, qícì shì guīhuà gè zhǒng zhìdù, shǐ guójiā wěndìng de chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: The government's most main task should be to maintain and protect social security; next is to plan various systems so that the country can grow stably.

examples.chinese: 他很喜歡買文具，尤其是筆，各國進口的原子筆他都有。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuān mǎi wénjù, yóuqí shì bǐ, gè guó jìnkǒu de yuánzǐbǐ tā dōu yǒu.
examples.english: He really likes buying stationery, especially pens; he has ballpoint pens imported from various countries.

examples.chinese: 他迷上足球，所以買了各式各樣的足球鞋。
examples.pinyin: Tā mí shàng zúqiú, suǒyǐ mǎi le gè shì gè yàng de zúqiú xié.
examples.english: He is fascinated by soccer, so he bought all kinds of soccer shoes.

examples.chinese: 他從音樂學院畢業以後就加入歌劇團，到世界各地表演。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng yīnyuè xuéyuàn bìyè yǐhòu jiù jiārù gējùtuán, dào shìjiè gèdì biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: After graduating from the music conservatory, he joined an opera troupe and performed all over the world.

examples.chinese: 網路直播的內容各種各樣，甚至有人因為直播平日生活而變成明星。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù zhíbō de nèiróng gèzhǒng-gèyàng, shènzhì yǒu rén yīnwèi zhíbō píngrì shēnghuó ér biànchéng míngxīng.
examples.english: The content of live internet broadcasts is all kinds of things; some people even become stars because they live-broadcast their everyday life.

examples.chinese: 參加旅行團或自助旅遊各有各的優點，懶得自己安排行程的人，就跟著導遊走吧。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā lǚxíngtuán huò zìzhù lǚyóu gè yǒu gè de yōudiǎn, lǎn de zìjǐ ānpái xíngchéng de rén, jiù gēnzhe dǎoyóu zǒu ba.
examples.english: Joining a tour group or traveling independently each has its own advantages; those who are too lazy to arrange their own itinerary should just follow the tour guide.

examples.chinese: 這個城市夜晚因各種各樣的彩色燈光，而使得景色既浪漫又迷人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yèwǎn yīn gè zhǒng gè yàng de cǎisè dēngguāng, ér shǐde jǐngsè jì làngmàn yòu mírén.
examples.english: At night, this city, because of various colorful lights, makes the scenery both romantic and charming.

examples.chinese: 大自然除了有各種動植物，還有山地、平原、河流等等，這一切應該是上帝創造的。
examples.pinyin: Dàzìrán chúle yǒu gè zhǒng dòngzhíwù, hái yǒu shāndì, píngyuán, héliú děngděng, zhè yíqiè yīnggāi shì Shàngdì chuàngzào de.
examples.english: In addition to having various animals and plants, nature also has mountains, plains, rivers, and so on; all of this was presumably created by God.

examples.chinese: 我夢想有一天可以到世界各地旅行。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèngxiǎng yǒu yìtiān kěyǐ dào shìjiè gèdì lǚxíng.
examples.english: I dream of one day being able to travel to all parts of the world.

examples.chinese: 這條街道旁有各式各樣的商店與餐廳，假日時相當熱鬧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiēdào páng yǒu gèshìgèyàng de shāngdiàn yǔ cāntīng, jiàrì shí xiāngdāng rènao.
examples.english: Along this street there are all kinds of shops and restaurants; on holidays it is quite bustling.

examples.chinese: 我對人體各部分的功能很有興趣，不過我沒想過當醫生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì réntǐ gè bùfèn de gōngnéng hěn yǒu xìngqù, bùguò wǒ méi xiǎngguò dāng yīshēng.
examples.english: I'm very interested in the functions of the various parts of the human body, but I've never thought about becoming a doctor.

examples.chinese: 新員工在經過專門的訓練後，都已能使用工廠各種生產機器。
examples.pinyin: Xīn yuángōng zài jīngguò zhuānmén de xùnliàn hòu, dōu yǐ néng shǐyòng gōngchǎng gè zhǒng shēngchǎn jīqì.
examples.english: After receiving specialized training, the new employees are all now able to use the various production machines in the factory.

examples.chinese: 我們應該培養獨立思考的能力，別被身邊各種訊息左右。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi péiyǎng dúlì sīkǎo de nénglì, bié bèi shēnbiān gèzhǒng xùnxī zuǒyòu.
examples.english: We should cultivate the ability to think independently; don't be controlled by all kinds of information around you.

examples.chinese: 這次座談會邀請了各領域的人們，主要目的是對國內的地方建設提一些建議。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì zuòtánhuì yāoqǐng le gè lǐngyù de rénmen, zhǔyào mùdì shì duì guónèi de dìfāng jiànshè tí yìxiē jiànyì.
examples.english: This forum invited people from various fields; its main purpose is to offer some suggestions for domestic local construction.

examples.chinese: 個人在使用各式各樣的網路服務時，也應該注意隱私問題。
examples.pinyin: Gèrén zài shǐyòng gè shì gè yàng de wǎnglù fúwù shí, yě yīnggāi zhùyì yǐnsī wèntí.
examples.english: When individuals use various kinds of internet services, they should also pay attention to privacy issues.

examples.chinese: 他想寫一本以各行各業人物當作題材的長篇小說。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng xiě yī běn yǐ gègèhánggèyè rénwù dāngzuò tícái de chángpiān xiǎoshuō.
examples.english: He wants to write a full-length novel that uses people from all walks of life as its subject matter.

examples.chinese: 各行各業都有屬於自己的專業，無法比較誰高誰低。
examples.pinyin: Gè háng gè yè dōu yǒu shǔyú zìjǐ de zhuānyè, wúfǎ bǐjiào shéi gāo shéi dī.
examples.english: Every profession has its own specialty; it is impossible to compare who is higher and who is lower.

examples.chinese: 企業為了錄用合適的人才，而採用各式各樣的方式。
examples.pinyin: Qǐyè wèile lùyòng héshì de réncái, ér cǎiyòng gè shì gè yàng de fāngshì.
examples.english: Enterprises adopt various methods in order to hire suitable talent.

examples.chinese: 世界各地的神話雖然不見得都真實，卻能讓人們多少了解一些古代的風俗習慣。
examples.pinyin: Shìjiè gèdì de shénhuà suīrán bú jiàndé dōu zhēnshí, què néng ràng rénmen duōshǎo liǎojiě yīxiē gǔdài de fēngsú xíguàn.
examples.english: Although myths from around the world are not necessarily all true, they can still let people understand some ancient customs and habits to some extent.

examples.chinese: 雖然他已經親自說了對不起，但還是很後悔做出那樣沒禮貌的行為，於是再度向各位道歉。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán tā yǐjīng qīnzì shuō le duìbuqǐ, dàn háishì hěn hòuhuǐ zuòchū nàyàng méi lǐmào de xíngwéi, yúshì zàidù xiàng gèwèi dàoqiàn.
examples.english: Although he has already personally said sorry, he still very much regrets having behaved so impolitely, so he once again apologizes to everyone.

examples.chinese: 學校餐廳提供各式各樣的營養食品，供學生挑選。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào cāntīng tígōng gè shì gè yàng de yíngyǎng shípǐn, gōng xuéshēng tiāoxuǎn.
examples.english: The school cafeteria provides a variety of nutritious foods for students to choose from.

examples.chinese: 電腦工程師除了維護電腦，還要處理各種與電腦相關的問題。
examples.pinyin: Diànnǎo gōngchéngshī chúle wéihù diànnǎo, hái yào chǔlǐ gèzhǒng yǔ diànnǎo xiāngguān de wèntí.
examples.english: Computer engineers, in addition to maintaining computers, also have to handle various computer-related problems.

items.wordHook: Each 夂(go) takes its own 口(mouth) along → 各(individual).

examples.chinese: 你聞，那是什麼味道？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wén, nà shì shénme wèidào?
examples.english: Smell it—what is that smell?

examples.chinese: 我在公園散步的時候，聞到了花的香味。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài gōngyuán sànbù de shíhou, wén dào le huā de xiāngwèi.
examples.english: When I was taking a walk in the park, I smelled the fragrance of flowers.

examples.chinese: 電視新聞說，最近有很多人抱怨手機的電池有問題。
examples.pinyin: Diànshì xīnwén shuō, zuìjìn yǒu hěn duō rén bàoyuàn shǒujī de diànchí yǒu wèntí.
examples.english: TV news says that recently many people have complained that cell phone batteries have problems.

examples.chinese: 新聞報告說颱風快來了，出門時得注意安全。
examples.pinyin: Xīnwén bàogào shuō táifēng kuài lái le, chūmén shí děi zhùyì ānquán.
examples.english: The news report says a typhoon is coming soon; when going out, you must pay attention to safety.

examples.chinese: 那班飛機因為天氣的關係，沒辦法準時抵達。總統抵達新聞說明會的現場前，安全人員得先確認記者的資料，還得檢查他們的背包。
examples.pinyin: Nà bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì de guānxi, méi bànfǎ zhǔnshí dǐdá. Zǒngtǒng dǐdá xīnwén shuōmínghuì de xiànchǎng qián, ānquán rényuán děi xiān quèrèn jìzhě de zīliào, hái děi jiǎnchá tāmen de bēibāo.
examples.english: That flight could not arrive on time because of the weather. Before the president arrived at the press conference site, security personnel had to first confirm the reporters' information and also check their backpacks.

examples.chinese: 為了提高英文的聽力水平，我除了聽收音機的英文廣播，也會看美國的電視新聞。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le tígāo Yīngwén de tīnglì shuǐpíng, wǒ chú le tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō, yě huì kàn Měiguó de diànshì xīnwén.
examples.english: In order to improve my English listening level, besides listening to English radio broadcasts, I also watch American TV news.

examples.chinese: 只要打開手機，連上網路，就能立刻掌握全球新聞。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào dǎkāi shǒujī, liánshàng wǎnglù, jiù néng lìkè zhǎngwò quánqiú xīnwén.
examples.english: As long as you turn on your phone and connect to the internet, you can immediately grasp global news.

examples.chinese: 中國與美國之間的貿易問題很嚴重，這個新聞早就上電視了。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó yǔ Měiguó zhījiān de màoyì wèntí hěn yánzhòng, zhège xīnwén zǎo jiù shàng diànshì le.
examples.english: The trade issue between China and the United States is very serious; this news appeared on TV long ago.

examples.chinese: 最近酒後開車的車禍新聞越來越多，政府得好好處罰這些人。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn jiǔhòu kāichē de chēhuò xīnwén yuè lái yuè duō, zhèngfǔ děi hǎohǎo chǔfá zhèxiē rén.
examples.english: Recently there has been more and more news of car accidents from drunk driving; the government must properly punish these people.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠排出的黑煙不只氣味難聞，更可怕的是可能對肺部造成傷害。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng pái chū de hēiyān bùzhǐ qìwèi nánwén, gèng kěpà de shì kěnéng duì fèibù zàochéng shānghài.
examples.english: The black smoke emitted by that factory not only smells bad, but even more frighteningly, it may cause harm to the lungs.

examples.chinese: 從事電視新聞工作的人有義務傳播正確的消息。
examples.pinyin: Cóngshì diànshì xīnwén gōngzuò de rén yǒu yìwù chuánbō zhèngquè de xiāoxi.
examples.english: People working in television news have an obligation to disseminate correct information.

examples.chinese: 這位記者專門報導社會新聞，他報新聞的方式相當專業。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jìzhě zhuānmén bàodǎo shèhuì xīnwén, tā bào xīnwén de fāngshì xiāngdāng zhuānyè.
examples.english: This reporter specializes in reporting social news; the way he reports news is quite professional.

examples.chinese: 媽媽有時候會跟市場的老闆講價，希望價錢能便宜一點兒。
examples.pinyin: Māma yǒu shíhou huì gēn shìchǎng de lǎobǎn jiǎngjià, xīwàng jiàqián néng piányi yìdiǎnr.
examples.english: Mom sometimes bargains with the market vendors, hoping the price can be a little cheaper.

examples.chinese: 我週末還要工作，打算一下班就去看燈會。我們可以約友美一起去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhōumò hái yào gōngzuò, dǎsuàn yí xiàbān jiù qù kàn dēnghuì. Wǒmen kěyǐ yuē Yǒuměi yìqǐ qù.
examples.english: I have to work on weekends, and plan to go to the Lantern Carnival as soon as I get off from work. We can ask Youmei out for the Lantern Carnival together.

examples.chinese: 我很喜歡那個房子，看房子當天就跟房東簽約了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuān nàge fángzi, kàn fángzi dāngtiān jiù gēn fángdōng qiānyuē le.
examples.english: I really like that house; on the day I viewed it, I signed the contract with the landlord.

examples.chinese: 我答應朋友去KTV幫他過生日，沒想到當天我太忙，忘了這件事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dāyìng péngyou qù KTV bāng tā guò shēngrì, méi xiǎngdào dāngtiān wǒ tài máng, wàng le zhè jiàn shì.
examples.english: I promised my friend to go to KTV to celebrate his birthday, but I didn't expect that I would be too busy that day and forgot about this matter.

examples.chinese: 為了參加同事的婚禮，我打算當天穿上很有特色的中國傳統服裝。
examples.pinyin: Wèile cānjiā tóngshì de hūnlǐ, wǒ dǎsuàn dāngtiān chuān shàng hěn yǒu tèsè de Zhōngguó chuántǒng fúzhuāng.
examples.english: In order to attend my colleague's wedding, I plan to wear very distinctive traditional Chinese clothing on that day.

examples.chinese: 畢業當天，許多學生帶著攝影機在校園裡攝影，留下了珍貴的回憶。
examples.pinyin: Bìyè dāngtiān, xǔduō xuéshēng dài zhe shèyǐngjī zài xiàoyuán lǐ shèyǐng, liú xià le zhēnguì de huíyì.
examples.english: On graduation day, many students brought cameras and took pictures on campus, leaving behind precious memories.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣鐵路局的網站訂票，一人最多只能訂六張搭車當天的票。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān Tiělùjú de wǎngzhàn dìng piào, yī rén zuìduō zhǐ néng dìng liù zhāng dā chē dāngtiān de piào.
examples.english: When booking tickets on the Taiwan Railways Administration website, each person can book at most six tickets for the day of travel.

examples.chinese: 莫以凡覺得推薦的「薦」很難寫，連他的台灣朋友也常寫錯。
examples.pinyin: Mò Yǐfán juéde tuījiàn de “jiàn” hěn nán xiě, lián tā de Táiwān péngyǒu yě cháng xiě cuò.
examples.english: Mo Yifan thinks the character 'jian' in 'recommend' is hard to write; even his Taiwanese friends often write it wrong.

examples.chinese: 我最近快窮死了，連三明治也吃不起，只好跟朋友借錢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn kuài qióng sǐ le, lián sānmíngzhì yě chī bù qǐ, zhǐhǎo gēn péngyǒu jiè qián.
examples.english: I'm almost poor to death lately—I can't even afford a sandwich, so I have no choice but to borrow money from friends.

examples.chinese: 那個孩子可真勇敢！連看到蛇也不害怕。
examples.pinyin: Nàge háizi kě zhēn yǒnggǎn! Lián kàn dào shé yě bú hàipà.
examples.english: That child is certainly brave! He is not even afraid when he sees a snake.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，不少大學教室裡的桌、椅是連在一起的，搬起來有點重。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, bùshǎo dàxué jiàoshì lǐ de zhuō, yǐ shì lián zài yìqǐ de, bān qǐlái yǒudiǎn zhòng.
examples.english: In Taiwan, the desks and chairs in many university classrooms are joined together, so they are a bit heavy to move.

examples.chinese: 那對雙胞胎姐妹不但長得很像，連性格也一樣開朗、大方。
examples.pinyin: Nà duì shuāngbāotāi jiěmèi bùdàn zhǎng de hěn xiàng, lián xìnggé yě yíyàng kāilǎng, dàfāng.
examples.english: That pair of twin sisters not only look very much alike, but even their personalities are equally cheerful and generous.

examples.chinese: 尚恩是家豪的好朋友，非常清楚他的個性，連他喜歡吃什麼都很清楚。
examples.pinyin: Shàng'ēn shì Jiāháo de hǎo péngyou, fēicháng qīngchǔ tā de gèxìng, lián tā xǐhuān chī shénme dōu hěn qīngchǔ.
examples.english: Shawn is Jiahao's good friend and is very clear about his personality; he is even very clear about what he likes to eat.

examples.chinese: 下了好幾天的大雨，不但到處淹水，連我家養的雞、鴨也淹死了。
examples.pinyin: Xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de dàyǔ, bùdàn dàochù yānshuǐ, lián wǒ jiā yǎng de jī, yā yě yān sǐ le.
examples.english: It rained heavily for several days; not only was there flooding everywhere, but even the chickens and ducks we raise at home drowned.

examples.chinese: 這幾天電視上一連播了好幾部同一位導演拍的電影，一部比一部好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān diànshì shàng yīlián bō le hǎo jǐ bù tóng yī wèi dǎoyǎn pāi de diànyǐng, yī bù bǐ yī bù hǎokàn.
examples.english: These past few days, the TV has played several movies directed by the same director in succession; each one is better than the last.

examples.chinese: 這個星期經理一連寫了三個推銷新產品的計畫，每天都忙得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīngqī jīnglǐ yīlián xiě le sān gè tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de jìhuà, měi tiān dōu máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: This week the manager wrote three plans for promoting new products in succession; he is extremely busy every day.

examples.chinese: 這個地區是個危險地帶，因為經常一下雨就有石頭掉下來，有時候連路都會塌了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū shì ge wēixiǎn dìdài, yīnwèi jīngcháng yí xià yǔ jiù yǒu shítou diào xiàlái, yǒu shíhou lián lù dōu huì tā le.
examples.english: This area is a dangerous zone, because whenever it rains, rocks often fall, and sometimes even the road collapses.

examples.chinese: 弟弟感冒了，可是他不但不吃藥，還一連吃了三碗冰，結果咳嗽咳得越來越嚴重了。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi gǎnmào le, kěshì tā búdàn bù chī yào, hái yíliàn chī le sān wǎn bīng, jiéguǒ késou ké de yuèláiyuè yánzhòng le.
examples.english: My younger brother caught a cold, but not only did he not take medicine, he even ate three bowls of ice cream in a row; as a result, his cough became more and more serious.

examples.chinese: 這次強烈地震造成了嚴重的災情，不但許多房屋塌了，連橋也斷了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qiángliè dìzhèn zàochéng le yánzhòng de zāiqíng, búdàn xǔduō fángwū tā le, lián qiáo yě duàn le.
examples.english: This strong earthquake caused severe damage due to the disaster; not only did many houses collapse, but even bridges broke.

examples.chinese: 東部山區一連下了好幾天的大雨，有些房子倒了，公路也塌了，造成不少意外。
examples.pinyin: Dōngbù shānqū yíliàn xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de dàyǔ, yǒuxiē fángzi dǎo le, gōnglù yě tā le, zàochéng bùshǎo yìwài.
examples.english: In the eastern mountain area, it rained heavily for several days in a row; some houses collapsed, and the highway also collapsed, causing many accidents.

examples.chinese: 這個地區因為到處淹水，走路、開車都很困難，連網路也不通了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū yīnwèi dàochù yānshuǐ, zǒulù, kāichē dōu hěn kùnnán, lián wǎnglù yě bù tōng le.
examples.english: Because this area is flooded everywhere, walking and driving are very difficult, and even the internet is not working.

examples.chinese: 因為水災的關係，許多學校沒辦法正常上課，甚至連便利商店都關了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi shuǐzāi de guānxi, xǔduō xuéxiào méi bànfǎ zhèngcháng shàngkè, shènzhì lián biànlì shāngdiàn dōu guān le.
examples.english: Because of the flood, many schools cannot have classes normally; even convenience stores have closed.

examples.chinese: 這個城市一連下了五天的雨，造成很多地區淹水，三分之一的路不通了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yīlián xià le wǔ tiān de yǔ, zàochéng hěnduō dìqū yānshuǐ, sān fēn zhī yī de lù bù tōng le.
examples.english: It rained for five days in a row in this city, causing flooding in many areas, and one third of the roads are impassable.

examples.chinese: 公司很重視員工的身心健康，每年都安排一連五天的環島旅行，家人也可以參加。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī hěn zhòngshì yuángōng de shēnxīn jiànkāng, měi nián dōu ānpái yīlián wǔ tiān de huándǎo lǚxíng, jiārén yě kěyǐ cānjiā.
examples.english: The company places great importance on the physical and mental health of its employees, and every year arranges a five-day island tour, which family members can also join.

examples.chinese: 珍珍每天大約看兩個小時的臺灣連續劇，目的是要(訓)練自己的中文聽力。大雄常利用週末練(習)書法，所以漢字寫得比其他同學都好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhēn měitiān dàyuē kàn liǎng ge xiǎoshí de Táiwān liánxùjù, mùdì shì yào xùnliàn zìjǐ de Zhōngwén tīnglì. Dàxióng cháng lìyòng zhōumò liànxí shūfǎ, suǒyǐ Hànzì xiě de bǐ qítā tóngxué dōu hǎokàn.
examples.english: Zhenzhen watches about two hours of Taiwanese TV dramas every day; her purpose is to train her Chinese listening comprehension. Daxiong often uses his weekends to practice calligraphy, so he writes Chinese characters more beautifully than any of his classmates.

examples.chinese: 我奶奶不會用電腦，每次想跟朋友連絡，不是去郵局寄信就是打家裡的電話。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai bú huì yòng diànnǎo, měi cì xiǎng gēn péngyǒu liánluò, bú shì qù yóujú jì xìn jiù shì dǎ jiālǐ de diànhuà.
examples.english: My grandmother doesn't know how to use a computer. Every time she wants to contact her friends, she either goes to the post office to mail a letter or calls the home phone.

examples.chinese: 氣象預報說，從明天起一連三天，中部以北地氣溫只有十五度，出門時最好加件外套。
examples.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào shuō, cóng míngtiān qǐ yīlián sān tiān, zhōngbù yǐběi dìqū qìwēn zhǐyǒu shíwǔ dù, chūmén shí zuìhǎo jiā jiàn wàitào.
examples.english: The weather forecast says that starting tomorrow for three days in a row, the temperature in the central and northern regions will be only 15 degrees; when going out, it's best to add a jacket.

examples.chinese: 對連電腦都不知道怎麼打開的人來說，上網購物是一件非常困難的事情。
examples.pinyin: Duì lián diànnǎo dōu bù zhīdào zěnme dǎkāi de rén lái shuō, shàngwǎng gòuwù shì yī jiàn fēicháng kùnnán de shìqíng.
examples.english: For people who don't even know how to turn on a computer, shopping online is a very difficult thing.

examples.chinese: 這次地震的規模很大，連總統一時也很難掌握各地的災情。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì dìzhèn de guīmó hěn dà, lián zǒngtǒng yīshí yě hěn nán zhǎngwò gèdì de zāiqíng.
examples.english: The scale of this earthquake was very large; even the president had difficulty grasping the disaster situation in various places for a while.

examples.chinese: 小陳認為頭痛是小事，況且最近忙得連休息的時間都不夠，所以不肯去看病。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Chén rènwéi tóutòng shì xiǎoshì, kuàngqiě zuìjìn máng de lián xiūxi de shíjiān dōu bù gòu, suǒyǐ bù kěn qù kànbìng.
examples.english: Xiǎo Chén thinks a headache is a small matter; furthermore, recently he has been so busy that he doesn't even have enough time to rest, so he refuses to see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 張經理今天的工作行程安排得很滿，連吃飯、休息的時間都沒有。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng jīnglǐ jīntiān de gōngzuò xíngchéng ānpái de hěn mǎn, lián chīfàn, xiūxi de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
examples.english: Manager Zhang's work schedule today is arranged very full; he doesn't even have time to eat or rest.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風引起的水災太嚴重，害大家一連五天沒有乾淨的水可以用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng yǐnqǐ de shuǐzāi tài yánzhòng, hài dàjiā yīlián wǔ tiān méiyǒu gānjìng de shuǐ kěyǐ yòng.
examples.english: The flood caused by this typhoon was too serious, causing everyone to go five days in a row without clean water to use.

examples.chinese: 小連跟老闆吵架而離開了公司，為了讓家人能繼續過安定的生活，他正努力地找新工作。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lián gēn lǎobǎn chǎojià ér líkāi le gōngsī, wèile ràng jiārén néng jìxù guò āndìng de shēnghuó, tā zhèng nǔlì de zhǎo xīn gōngzuò.
examples.english: Xiao Lian left the company after quarreling with the boss; in order to let his family continue to live a safe and stable life, he is working hard to find a new job.

examples.chinese: 你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le. Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé. Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english: The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends. After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam. Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 我打工的餐廳一到週末就客滿，忙不過來的時候，連老闆的叔叔都得來幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎgōng de cāntīng yí dào zhōumò jiù kèmǎn, máng bú guòlái de shíhou, lián lǎobǎn de shūshu dōu děi lái bāngmáng.
examples.english: The restaurant where I work part-time is full every weekend; when they are too busy to manage, even the boss's uncle has to come help.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹很會做家事，她總是把房間整理得很整齊，連窗戶也擦得很乾淨。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei hěn huì zuò jiāshì, tā zǒngshì bǎ fángjiān zhěnglǐ de hěn zhěngqí, lián chuānghu yě cā de hěn gānjìng.
examples.english: My younger sister is very good at doing housework; she always tidies up the room very neatly, and even wipes the windows very clean.

examples.chinese: A:為什麼活動中心連一個人都沒有？今天不是有吉他社的表演嗎？ B:你搞錯了，演出日期是下個星期三。
examples.pinyin: A: Wèishénme huódòng zhōngxīn lián yí ge rén dōu méiyǒu? Jīntiān bú shì yǒu jítā shè de biǎoyǎn ma? B: Nǐ gǎo cuò le, yǎnchū rìqī shì xià ge xīngqīsān.
examples.english: A: Why is there not a single person at the activity center? Isn't there a guitar club performance today? B: You got it wrong; the performance date is next Wednesday.

examples.chinese: 連先生很年輕的時候就當了國小校長，當年他才三十歲。
examples.pinyin: Lián xiānsheng hěn niánqīng de shíhou jiù dāng le guóxiǎo xiàozhǎng, dāngnián tā cái sānshí suì.
examples.english: Mr. Lian became an elementary school principal when he was very young; in those days he was only thirty years old.

examples.chinese: 那個美國人每天看臺灣的連續劇，一方面學習中文，一方面了解臺灣的生活文化。
examples.pinyin: Nàge Měiguórén měitiān kàn Táiwān de liánxùjù, yìfāngmiàn xuéxí Zhōngwén, yìfāngmiàn liǎojiě Táiwān de shēnghuó wénhuà.
examples.english: That American watches Taiwanese TV series every day: on one hand to learn Chinese, on the other hand to understand Taiwanese life and culture.

examples.chinese: 只要打開手機，連上網路，就能立刻掌握全球新聞。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào dǎkāi shǒujī, liánshàng wǎnglù, jiù néng lìkè zhǎngwò quánqiú xīnwén.
examples.english: As long as you turn on your phone and connect to the internet, you can immediately grasp global news.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的芒果冰好吃得沒話說，連吃過的外國人也十分滿意。A:今年銷售商品的成績比以往差， 大家都說是你的責任。 B:你是我最好的朋友，連你也這麼認為，我就沒話說了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Táiwān de mángguǒ bīng hǎochī de méi huà shuō, lián chī guò de wàiguórén yě shífēn mǎnyì. 2. A: Jīnnián xiāoshòu shāngpǐn de chéngjì bǐ yǐwǎng chà, dàjiā dōu shuō shì nǐ de zérèn. B: Nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, lián nǐ yě zhème rènwéi, wǒ jiù méi huà shuō le.
examples.english: 1. Taiwan's mango shaved ice is delicious beyond words; even foreigners who have tried it are extremely satisfied. 2. A: This year's product sales performance is worse than before; everyone says it's your responsibility. B: You are my best friend, and even you think so—then I have nothing to say.

examples.chinese: 到地震災區救災的軍人們，這幾天忙得連一頓飯都沒辦法好好地吃。
examples.pinyin: Dào dìzhèn zāiqū jiùzāi de jūnrénmen, zhè jǐ tiān máng de lián yí dùn fàn dōu méi bànfǎ hǎohǎo de chī.
examples.english: The soldiers who went to the earthquake disaster area for rescue have been so busy these days that they couldn't even properly eat a single meal.

examples.chinese: 連警察都證明這個車禍是段老闆喝醉造成的，可是他仍然不肯承認。
examples.pinyin: Lián jǐngchá dōu zhèngmíng zhège chēhuò shì Duàn lǎobǎn hē zuì zàochéng de, kěshì tā réngrán bù kěn chéngrèn.
examples.english: Even the police proved that this car accident was caused by Boss Duan getting drunk, but he still refuses to admit it.

examples.chinese: 他這個月花了太多錢，因此連水電費、房租都繳不出來。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhège yuè huā le tài duō qián, yīncǐ lián shuǐdiànfèi, fángzū dōu jiǎo bù chūlái.
examples.english: He spent too much money this month, so he can't even pay his water and electricity bills and rent.

examples.chinese: 在我們學校，上課時是不能使用手機的，連老師也不能破壞規定。那所學校規定學生不能帶手機上學，是希望他們專心學習。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒmen xuéxiào, shàngkè shí shì bù néng shǐyòng shǒujī de, lián lǎoshī yě bù néng pòhuài guīdìng. Nà suǒ xuéxiào guīdìng xuéshēng bù néng dài shǒujī shàngxué, shì xīwàng tāmen zhuānxīn xuéxí.
examples.english: At our school, you cannot use mobile phones during class—even teachers cannot break the rule. That school stipulates that students cannot bring mobile phones to school because it hopes they will concentrate on their studies.

examples.chinese: 前主任一天到晚做研究，連周末也不休息，這樣身體怎麼受得了？
examples.pinyin: Qián zhǔrèn yītiāndàowǎn zuò yánjiū, lián zhōumò yě bù xiūxi, zhèyàng shēntǐ zěnme shòudeliǎo?
examples.english: The former director did research all day long, not even resting on weekends; how could his body endure that?

examples.chinese: 過年時什麼都漲，連搭計程車的時候，車費都漲價了。
examples.pinyin: Guònián shí shénme dōu zhǎng, lián dā jìchéngchē de shíhou, chēfèi dōu zhǎngjià le.
examples.english: During Chinese New Year everything goes up in price; even when taking a taxi, the fare has increased.

examples.chinese: 他今天忙得不得了，連喝一口水的時間都沒有。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān máng de bùdéliǎo, lián hē yī kǒu shuǐ de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
examples.english: He is incredibly busy today; he doesn't even have time for a single mouthful of water.

examples.chinese: 這個題目怪難的，連老師都要想很久。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge tímù guài nán de, lián lǎoshī dōu yào xiǎng hěn jiǔ.
examples.english: This question is quite difficult; even the teacher has to think about it for a long time.

examples.chinese: 有人一天到晚總看著手機，連錯過了精彩的生活時刻也不知道。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén yìtiāndàowǎn zǒng kànzhe shǒujī, lián cuòguòle jīngcǎi de shēnghuó shíkè yě bù zhīdào.
examples.english: Some people always look at their phones from morning till night, and don't even know when they've missed wonderful moments in life.

examples.chinese: 伯父的孩子是對雙胞胎，不只是樣子，連說話的聲音都像。
examples.pinyin: Bófù de háizi shì duì shuāngbāotāi, bù zhǐshì yàngzi, lián shuōhuà de shēngyīn dōu xiàng.
examples.english: My uncle's children are a pair of twins; not only do they look alike, even their speaking voices are similar.

examples.chinese: 小王的閱讀報告寫得很精彩，連教授都在課堂上當面誇獎他。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng de yuèdú bàogào xiě de hěn jīngcǎi, lián jiàoshòu dōu zài kètáng shàng dāngmiàn kuājiǎng tā.
examples.english: Xiao Wang's reading report was written wonderfully; even the professor praised him to his face in class.

examples.chinese: 戴小姐的父母對婚禮相當重視，連喜帖都是他們親自設計的。
examples.pinyin: Dài xiǎojiě de fùmǔ duì hūnlǐ xiāngdāng zhòngshì, lián xǐtiě dōu shì tāmen qīnzì shèjì de.
examples.english: Miss Dai's parents place great importance on the wedding; even the wedding invitations were designed by them personally.

examples.chinese: 連經理很講話，開會時老是說個不停，別人都沒說話的分。
examples.pinyin: Lián jīnglǐ hěn jiǎng huà, kāihuì shí lǎoshì shuō gè bù tíng, biérén dōu méi shuōhuà de fèn.
examples.english: Manager Lian talks a lot; during meetings he never stops talking, and others have no share of the speaking.

examples.chinese: 她最近失眠了，連吃了三天的藥也沒改善。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn shīmián le, lián chī le sān tiān de yào yě méi gǎishàn.
examples.english: She has had insomnia recently; she took medicine for three days in a row and still didn't improve.

examples.chinese: 化裝舞會上他打扮成一具機器人，連說話走路都模仿機器人。
examples.pinyin: Huàzhuāng wǔhuì shàng tā dǎbàn chéng yī jù jīqìrén, lián shuōhuà zǒulù dōu mófǎng jīqìrén.
examples.english: At the masquerade ball, he dressed up as a robot, even imitating a robot when speaking and walking.

examples.chinese: 他很聰明，成績又非常好，因此完成初級班的課程後，學校讓他跳過中級，到高級班學習，一連跳了兩級。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn cōngmíng, chéngjì yòu fēicháng hǎo, yīncǐ wánchéng chūjí bān de kèchéng hòu, xuéxiào ràng tā tiàoguò zhōngjí, dào gāojí bān xuéxí, yīlián tiào le liǎng jí.
examples.english: He is very smart and his grades are also excellent, so after completing the beginner-level class curriculum, the school let him skip the intermediate level and study in the advanced class—he skipped two levels in a row.

examples.chinese: 那位模特兒曾多次參與連續劇演出，相當受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi mótèér céng duō cì cānyù liánxùjù yǎnchū, xiāngdāng shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: That model has participated in TV drama performances many times and is quite popular.

examples.chinese: 擲標槍、射箭、開槍(to shoot)需要的技巧都不同，想熟練就得多連練習。
examples.pinyin: Zhì biāoqiāng, shèjiàn, kāiqiāng xūyào de jìqiǎo dōu bùtóng, xiǎng shúliàn jiù děi duō liànxí.
examples.english: The skills required for javelin throwing, archery, and shooting a gun are all different; if you want to become proficient, you must practice more.

items.wordHook: Along the winding 辶(movement) trail, one supply 車(cart) links to the next to 連(join).

examples.chinese: 救護車開得很快，因為要救人一命。
examples.pinyin: Jiùhùchē kāi de hěn kuài, yīnwèi yào jiù rén yī mìng.
examples.english: The ambulance drove very fast, because it needed to save a person's life.

examples.chinese: 強烈颱風快來了，救災中心對民眾發出警告，為了自己的生命安全，絕對別去海邊。小游經常喝了酒還開車回家，太太警告他如果不改掉這個壞習慣，就要跟他離婚。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè táifēng kuài lái le, jiùzāi zhōngxīn duì mínzhòng fāchū jǐnggào, wèile zìjǐ de shēngmìng ānquán, juéduì bié qù hǎibiān. Xiǎo Yóu jīngcháng hē le jiǔ hái kāichē huí jiā, tàitai jǐnggào tā rúguǒ bù gǎidiào zhège huài xíguàn, jiù yào gēn tā líhūn.
examples.english: A strong typhoon is coming soon; the disaster relief center issued a warning to the public: for your own safety, absolutely do not go to the beach. Xiao You often drives home after drinking; his wife warned him that if he doesn't change this bad habit, she will divorce him.

examples.chinese: 中華民族在世界上有五、六千年的歷史了。
examples.pinyin: Zhōnghuá mínzú zài shìjiè shàng yǒu wǔ, liù qiān nián de lìshǐ le.
examples.english: The Chinese nation has a history of five to six thousand years in the world.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己特殊的風俗習慣，有時候外國人不容易了解。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ tèshū de fēngsú xíguàn, yǒu shíhou wàiguó rén bù róngyì liǎojiě.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own special customs and habits, which sometimes foreigners find hard to understand.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己獨特的習俗，像華人除夕貼春聯、年夜飯的魚不能吃光就很特別。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ dútè de xísú, xiàng Huárén chúxī tiē chūnlián, niányèfàn de yú bù néng chī guāng jiù hěn tèbié.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own unique customs. For example, it is very special that Chinese people put up spring couplets on New Year's Eve and that the fish for the New Year's Eve dinner cannot be completely eaten.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己的語言和文字，也用它們來記錄歷史。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ de yǔyán hé wénzì, yě yòng tāmen lái jìlù lìshǐ.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own language and writing, and also uses them to record history.

examples.chinese: 博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的。每個人的生命價值都是一樣的，不應該為了自己的利益而犧牲別人。
examples.pinyin: 1. Bówùguǎn lǐ de dōngxi fēicháng bǎoguì, tāmen jùyǒu mínzú hé wénhuà de jiàzhí, méi bànfǎ yòng qián suàn qīngchu de. 2. Měi gè rén de shēngmìng jiàzhí dōu shì yīyàng de, bù yīnggāi wèile zìjǐ de lìyì ér xīshēng biérén.
examples.english: 1. The things in the museum are very precious; they have ethnic and cultural value and cannot be calculated clearly with money. 2. Everyone's value of life is the same; one should not sacrifice others for one's own interests.

examples.chinese: 許多世紀以來，受壓迫的民族都渴望擁有平等的待遇。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō shìjì yǐlái, shòu yāpò de mínzú dōu kěwàng yǒngyǒu píngděng de dàiyù.
examples.english: For many centuries, oppressed peoples have longed for equal treatment.

examples.chinese: 滑雪是很刺激的活動，需要很好的技巧。李小姐受不了離婚的刺激，已經好幾天吃不好、睡不好了。
examples.pinyin: Huáxuě shì hěn cìjī de huódòng, xūyào hěn hǎo de jìqiǎo. Lǐ xiǎojiě shòu bù liǎo líhūn de cìjī, yǐjīng hǎo jǐ tiān chī bù hǎo, shuì bù hǎo le.
examples.english: Skiing is a very exciting activity that requires good skills. Miss Li couldn't handle the shock of divorce, and has been unable to eat or sleep well for several days.

examples.chinese: 強烈颱風快來了，救災中心對民眾發出警告，為了自己的生命安全，絕對別去海邊。小游經常喝了酒還開車回家，太太警告他如果不改掉這個壞習慣，就要跟他離婚。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè táifēng kuài lái le, jiùzāi zhōngxīn duì mínzhòng fāchū jǐnggào, wèile zìjǐ de shēngmìng ānquán, juéduì bié qù hǎibiān. Xiǎo Yóu jīngcháng hē le jiǔ hái kāichē huí jiā, tàitai jǐnggào tā rúguǒ bù gǎidiào zhège huài xíguàn, jiù yào gēn tā líhūn.
examples.english: A strong typhoon is coming soon; the disaster relief center issued a warning to the public: for your own safety, absolutely do not go to the beach. Xiao You often drives home after drinking; his wife warned him that if he doesn't change this bad habit, she will divorce him.

examples.chinese: 結婚之前，那對情侶認真規劃了未來的生活，沒想到結婚一個月之後就離婚了。
examples.pinyin: Jiéhūn zhīqián, nà duì qínglǚ rènzhēn guīhuà le wèilái de shēnghuó, méi xiǎngdào jiéhūn yí ge yuè zhīhòu jiù líhūn le.
examples.english: Before getting married, that couple carefully planned their future life; unexpectedly, they divorced just one month after getting married.

examples.chinese: A:聽說小金離婚了，你知道是怎麼回事嗎？ B:唉，這件事說起來都要怪小金，誰教他愛上了別的女生呢！
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō Xiǎo Jīn líhūn le, nǐ zhīdào shì zěnme huí shì ma? B: Āi, zhè jiàn shì shuō qǐlái dōu yào guài Xiǎo Jīn, shéi jiào tā ài shàng le bié de nǚshēng ne!
examples.english: A: I heard Xiao Jin got divorced. Do you know what happened? B: Sigh, as a matter of fact, it's all Xiao Jin's fault—who told him to fall in love with another girl!

examples.chinese: 小李離婚後才知道失去老婆很痛苦，不過後悔也來不及了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ líhūn hòu cái zhīdào shīqù lǎopo hěn tòngkǔ, bùguò hòuhuǐ yě láibují le.
examples.english: Only after divorcing did Little Li realize that losing his wife is very painful, but it's too late to be regretful.

examples.chinese: 哥哥的性格開朗、樂觀，遇到麻煩也不會往壞處想。
examples.pinyin: Gēge de xìnggé kāilǎng, lèguān, yùdào máfan yě bù huì wǎng huàichù xiǎng.
examples.english: My older brother has a cheerful and optimistic personality; even when he encounters trouble, he won't think about the bad side.

examples.chinese: 那對雙胞胎姐妹不但長得很像，連性格也一樣開朗、大方。
examples.pinyin: Nà duì shuāngbāotāi jiěmèi bùdàn zhǎng de hěn xiàng, lián xìnggé yě yíyàng kāilǎng, dàfāng.
examples.english: That pair of twin sisters not only look very much alike, but even their personalities are equally cheerful and generous.

examples.chinese: 我哥哥開朗活潑、高大英俊，難怪有很多女生追求他。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēge kāilǎng huópō, gāodà yīngjùn, nánguài yǒu hěnduō nǚshēng zhuīqiú tā.
examples.english: My older brother is cheerful and lively, tall and handsome; no wonder many girls pursue him.

examples.chinese: 在所有的同事中，我覺得小周最好相處了。他的性格開朗、說話幽默，還常主動幫忙，跟他相處起來很愉快、很自在。
examples.pinyin: Zài suǒyǒu de tóngshì zhōng, wǒ juéde Xiǎo Zhōu zuì hǎo xiāngchǔ le. Tā de xìnggé kāilǎng, shuōhuà yōumò, hái cháng zhǔdòng bāngmáng, gēn tā xiāngchǔ qǐlái hěn yúkuài, hěn zìzài.
examples.english: Among all my colleagues, I think Xiao Zhou is the easiest to get along with. He has a cheerful personality, speaks humorously, and often offers help proactively; getting along with him is very pleasant and relaxed.

examples.chinese: 你別看她一臉害羞的樣子，在熟人面前她可是很開朗的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié kàn tā yī liǎn hàixiū de yàngzi, zài shúrén miànqián tā kěshì hěn kāilǎng de.
examples.english: Don't judge her by her shy appearance; in front of acquaintances she is actually very cheerful.

examples.chinese: 如果只注意別人的缺點，就永遠看不到他們的優點了。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhǐ zhùyì biérén de quēdiǎn, jiù yǒngyuǎn kàn bù dào tāmen de yōudiǎn le.
examples.english: If you only pay attention to others' shortcomings, you will never see their strengths.

examples.chinese: 每個人都有自己的優點，不需要強調，也不必跟別人比來比去。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de yōudiǎn, bù xūyào qiángdiào, yě búbì gēn biérén bǐ lái bǐ qù.
examples.english: Everyone has their own strengths; there is no need to emphasize them, and no need to compare yourself with others back and forth.

examples.chinese: 參加旅行團或自助旅遊各有各的優點，懶得自己安排行程的人，就跟著導遊走吧。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā lǚxíngtuán huò zìzhù lǚyóu gè yǒu gè de yōudiǎn, lǎn de zìjǐ ānpái xíngchéng de rén, jiù gēnzhe dǎoyóu zǒu ba.
examples.english: Joining a tour group or traveling independently each has its own advantages; those who are too lazy to arrange their own itinerary should just follow the tour guide.

examples.chinese: 聽說那位新郎在事業上很有成就，況且優點也不少，跟他結婚的女人應該很幸福。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà wèi xīnláng zài shìyè shàng hěn yǒu chéngjiù, kuàngqiě yōudiǎn yě bù shǎo, gēn tā jiéhūn de nǚrén yīnggāi hěn xìngfú.
examples.english: I heard that bridegroom has great achievements in his career, and moreover has many good qualities; the woman who marries him should be very happy.

examples.chinese: 看見別人事業很成功，除了羨慕以外，更要學習他的優點。
examples.pinyin: Kànjiàn biérén shìyè hěn chénggōng, chúle xiànmù yǐwài, gèng yào xuéxí tā de yōudiǎn.
examples.english: When you see others being very successful in their careers, besides envying them, you should also learn from their strengths.

items.wordHook: Viewing 優(superior) scenery at this designated 點(point): 優點 means advantage, merit.

examples.chinese: 小簡向很多公司自我推薦，經過了幾個月，最後找到了滿意的工作。經過跟父母的討論，大中決定先出國遊學一年，再回來念大學。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn xiàng hěn duō gōngsī zìwǒ tuījiàn, jīngguò le jǐ ge yuè, zuìhòu zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò. Jīngguò gēn fùmǔ de tǎolùn, Dàzhōng juédìng xiān chūguó yóuxué yì nián, zài huílái niàn dàxué.
examples.english: Xiao Jian recommended himself to many companies; after several months, he finally found a satisfactory job. After discussing with his parents, Dazhong decided to first study abroad for a year, and then come back to attend university.

examples.chinese: 你經過便利商店的時候，可以幫我買一瓶水嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīngguò biànlì shāngdiàn de shíhou, kěyǐ bāng wǒ mǎi yì píng shuǐ ma?
examples.english: When you pass by the convenience store, can you buy a bottle of water for me?

examples.chinese: 你回家經過賣韓國貨的超市時，可以順便幫我買兩包泡麵嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huíjiā jīngguò mài Hánguó huò de chāoshì shí, kěyǐ shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi liǎng bāo pàomiàn ma?
examples.english: When you pass by the supermarket that sells Korean merchandise on your way home, can you conveniently buy me two packs of instant noodles?

examples.chinese: 章先生一直想當律師，經過多年的努力，終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng yìzhí xiǎng dāng lǜshī, jīngguò duō nián de nǔlì, zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn le.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang has always wanted to be a lawyer. After years of effort, his dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese: 這條馬路高低不平，為了避免發生意外，開車經過時一定要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo mǎlù gāodī bù píng, wèile bìmiǎn fāshēng yìwài, kāichē jīngguò shí yīdìng yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: This road is uneven (high and low, not flat); in order to avoid accidents, you must be careful when driving through.

examples.chinese: 我的漢字考試總是不及格，經過三個月努力地練習，終於及格了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Hànzì kǎoshì zǒngshì bù jígé, jīngguò sān ge yuè nǔlì de liànxí, zhōngyú jígé le.
examples.english: I always fail my Chinese character exams; after three months of hard practice, I finally passed.

examples.chinese: 今天上午學校附近發生了車禍，經過警察處理後，現在交通已恢復正常。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shàngwǔ xuéxiào fùjìn fāshēng le chēhuò, jīngguò jǐngchá chǔlǐ hòu, xiànzài jiāotōng yǐ huīfù zhèngcháng.
examples.english: This morning a car accident occurred near the school. After the police handled it, traffic has now returned to normal.

examples.chinese: 路邊的攝影機錄到了房先生發生車禍的經過，讓警察順利抓到了害他受傷的人。
examples.pinyin: Lùbiān de shèyǐngjī lù dào le Fáng xiānsheng fāshēng chēhuò de jīngguò, ràng jǐngchá shùnlì zhuā dào le hài tā shòushāng de rén.
examples.english: The roadside camera recorded the course of Mr. Fang's car accident, allowing the police to smoothly catch the person who injured him.

examples.chinese: 經過服務人員詳細地說明，使得客人對公司的產品更了解了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò fúwù rényuán xiángxì de shuōmíng, shǐde kèrén duì gōngsī de chǎnpǐn gèng liǎojiě le.
examples.english: After the service staff's detailed explanation, it made the customers understand the company's products better.

examples.chinese: 每次看到有河流經過的都市，就會想起我生長的家鄉。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì kàndào yǒu héliú jīngguò de dūshì, jiù huì xiǎngqǐ wǒ shēngzhǎng de jiāxiāng.
examples.english: Every time I see a city with a river passing through it, I think of the hometown where I grew up.

examples.chinese: 他靠自己的力量，經過了十年，終於完成了這個發明。
examples.pinyin: Tā kào zìjǐ de lìliàng, jīngguò le shí nián, zhōngyú wánchéng le zhège fāmíng.
examples.english: Relying on his own strength, after ten years, he finally completed this invention.

examples.chinese: 新員工在經過專門的訓練後，都已能使用工廠各種生產機器。
examples.pinyin: Xīn yuángōng zài jīngguò zhuānmén de xùnliàn hòu, dōu yǐ néng shǐyòng gōngchǎng gè zhǒng shēngchǎn jīqì.
examples.english: After receiving specialized training, the new employees are all now able to use the various production machines in the factory.

examples.chinese: 我逛街時經過了一排小吃攤，就買幾樣回來當作宵夜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ guàngjiē shí jīngguò le yì pái xiǎochītān, jiù mǎi jǐ yàng huílái dàngzuò xiāoyè.
examples.english: When I was shopping, I passed a row of food stalls and bought a few items to bring back as a late-night snack.

examples.chinese: 經過我的說明，他反而有些糊塗了，看來我的解釋不太清楚。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò wǒ de shuōmíng, tā fǎn'ér yǒuxiē hútú le, kànlái wǒ de jiěshì bù tài qīngchu.
examples.english: After my explanation, he actually became somewhat confused; it seems my explanation wasn't very clear.

examples.chinese: 經過兩段不幸的感情生活，那位女士對愛情已失去了信心。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò liǎng duàn bùxìng de gǎnqíng shēnghuó, nà wèi nǚshì duì àiqíng yǐ shīqù le xìnxīn.
examples.english: After two unfortunate romantic relationships, that lady has already lost confidence in love.

examples.chinese: 經過那次任務教訓後，小周做事就變得更加小心了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò nà cì rènwu jiàoxùn hòu, Xiǎo Zhōu zuòshì jiù biàn de gèngjiā xiǎoxīn le.
examples.english: After the lesson from that mission, Xiao Zhou became even more careful in doing things.

examples.chinese: 早上在草地上散步，突然看見一條蛇經過，害得我一直流冷汗。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang zài cǎodì shàng sànbù, tūrán kànjiàn yī tiáo shé jīngguò, hàide wǒ yīzhí liú lěnghàn.
examples.english: While walking on the grass this morning, I suddenly saw a snake pass by, which made me keep breaking out in a cold sweat.

examples.chinese: 經過血液檢查，人們就可以知道自己的血型。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò xuèyè jiǎnchá, rénmen jiù kěyǐ zhīdào zìjǐ de xuèxíng.
examples.english: Through a blood test, people can know their own blood type.

examples.chinese: 經過這次手術，得了重病的嬰兒終於順利地保住了生命。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò zhè cì shǒushù, dé le zhòngbìng de yīng'ér zhōngyú shùnlì de bǎo zhù le shēngmìng.
examples.english: After this surgery, the seriously ill baby finally had its life successfully protected.

examples.chinese: 經過多次訓練，他總算贏得這場球賽的冠軍。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō cì xùnliàn, tā zǒngsuàn yíngdé zhè chǎng qiúsài de guànjūn.
examples.english: After many training sessions, he finally won the championship of this ball game.

examples.chinese: 下了好幾天的大雨，不但到處淹水，連我家養的雞、鴨也淹死了。
examples.pinyin: Xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de dàyǔ, bùdàn dàochù yānshuǐ, lián wǒ jiā yǎng de jī, yā yě yān sǐ le.
examples.english: It rained heavily for several days; not only was there flooding everywhere, but even the chickens and ducks we raise at home drowned.

examples.chinese: 這次的水災不僅淹了整條街，好幾家工廠也因為淹水沒辦法生產，真是太糟了！
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de shuǐzāi bùjǐn yān le zhěng tiáo jiē, hǎo jǐ jiā gōngchǎng yě yīnwèi yānshuǐ méi bànfǎ shēngchǎn, zhēn shì tài zāo le!
examples.english: This flooding not only flooded the entire street, but several factories also couldn't produce because of the flooding—it's really too bad!

examples.chinese: 這個地區因為到處淹水，走路、開車都很困難，連網路也不通了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū yīnwèi dàochù yānshuǐ, zǒulù, kāichē dōu hěn kùnnán, lián wǎnglù yě bù tōng le.
examples.english: Because this area is flooded everywhere, walking and driving are very difficult, and even the internet is not working.

examples.chinese: 這個城市一連下了五天的雨，造成很多地區淹水，三分之一的路不通了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yīlián xià le wǔ tiān de yǔ, zàochéng hěnduō dìqū yānshuǐ, sān fēn zhī yī de lù bù tōng le.
examples.english: It rained for five days in a row in this city, causing flooding in many areas, and one third of the roads are impassable.

examples.chinese: 前幾天因為颱風的關係，造成部分地區嚴重淹水，許多蔬果的價格都變高了。
examples.pinyin: Qián jǐ tiān yīnwèi táifēng de guānxì, zàochéng bùfèn dìqū yánzhòng yānshuǐ, xǔduō shūguǒ de jiàgé dōu biàn gāo le.
examples.english: A few days ago, because of the typhoon, some areas suffered severe flooding, and the prices of many vegetables and fruits have gone up.

examples.chinese: 前天的強烈颱風帶來了大雨，很多地方都淹水了。
examples.pinyin: Qiántiān de qiángliè táifēng dài lái le dàyǔ, hěn duō dìfāng dōu yānshuǐ le.
examples.english: The strong typhoon the day before yesterday brought heavy rain, and many places were flooded.

items.wordHook: When 氵(water) 奄(remains) instead of draining, you get a 淹(flood).

examples.chinese: 當軍隊一到達災區，就聽到了求救的聲音，所以立刻開始救災工作。
examples.pinyin: Dāng jūnduì yí dàodá zāiqū, jiù tīngdào le qiújiù de shēngyīn, suǒyǐ lìkè kāishǐ jiùzāi gōngzuò.
examples.english: As soon as the military arrived at the disaster area, they heard calls for help, so they immediately began disaster relief work.

items.wordHook: Combining 到(go to) and 達(reach): 到達 means arrive.

examples.chinese: 這堂課的內容跟文化有關，所以老師把教學重心放在介紹各國的文化特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng kè de nèiróng gēn wénhuà yǒuguān, suǒyǐ lǎoshī bǎ jiàoxué zhòngxīn fàng zài jièshào gè guó de wénhuà tèsè.
examples.english: The content of this class is related to culture, so the teacher put the teaching focus on introducing the cultural characteristics of various countries.

examples.chinese: 李小姐結婚以後的生活重心就是家庭，尤其是照顧剛出生的小孩。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě jiéhūn yǐhòu de shēnghuó zhòngxīn jiùshì jiātíng, yóuqí shì zhàogù gāng chūshēng de xiǎohái.
examples.english: After Miss Li got married, the focus of her life is her family, especially taking care of her newborn child.

examples.chinese: 華人送禮最重心意，以這種方式向收禮的人表達關心與祝福。
examples.pinyin: Huárén sònglǐ zuì zhòng xīnyì, yǐ zhè zhǒng fāngshì xiàng shōu lǐ de rén biǎodá guānxīn yǔ zhùfú.
examples.english: Chinese people place the greatest value on thoughtfulness when giving gifts, using this way to express care and blessings to the recipient.

items.wordHook: Combining 重(heavy) and 心(heart): 重心 means focus.

examples.chinese: 現在的電腦處理資料的速度比以往快得多，功能也更多了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài de diànnǎo chǔlǐ zīliào de sùdù bǐ yǐwǎng kuài de duō, gōngnéng yě gèng duō le.
examples.english: Today's computers process data much faster than in the past, and have more functions.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的芒果冰好吃得沒話說，連吃過的外國人也十分滿意。A:今年銷售商品的成績比以往差， 大家都說是你的責任。 B:你是我最好的朋友，連你也這麼認為，我就沒話說了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Táiwān de mángguǒ bīng hǎochī de méi huà shuō, lián chī guò de wàiguórén yě shífēn mǎnyì. 2. A: Jīnnián xiāoshòu shāngpǐn de chéngjì bǐ yǐwǎng chà, dàjiā dōu shuō shì nǐ de zérèn. B: Nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, lián nǐ yě zhème rènwéi, wǒ jiù méi huà shuō le.
examples.english: 1. Taiwan's mango shaved ice is delicious beyond words; even foreigners who have tried it are extremely satisfied. 2. A: This year's product sales performance is worse than before; everyone says it's your responsibility. B: You are my best friend, and even you think so—then I have nothing to say.

examples.chinese: 由於雲端科技的進步，人類的生活方式跟以往比起來有很大的差異。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yúnduān kējì de jìnbù, rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì gēn yǐwǎng bǐ qǐlái yǒu hěn dà de chāyì.
examples.english: Owing to advances in cloud technology, humans' way of life has great differences compared to the past.

examples.chinese: 以往在冬天才開的花，沒想到夏天就開了，大家都覺得很意外。
examples.pinyin: Yǐwǎng zài dōngtiān cái kāi de huā, méi xiǎngdào xiàtiān jiù kāi le, dàjiā dōu juéde hěn yìwài.
examples.english: Flowers that used to bloom only in winter unexpectedly bloomed in summer; everyone felt very surprised.

items.wordHook: Combining 以(according to) and 往(go): 以往 means formerly, in the past.
The celestial maiden who uses her loom to 織(weave) cloth as a divine 女(woman): 織女.

examples.chinese: 這面金牌是完全用金子做的，外觀也相當獨特。
examples.pinyin: Zhè miàn jīnpái shì wánquán yòng jīnzi zuò de, wàiguān yě xiāngdāng dútè.
examples.english: This gold medal is made entirely of gold, and its appearance is also quite unique.

items.wordHook: A handy item for 金(gold) with suffix 子(child): 金子 means gold.

examples.chinese: 刷卡買東西很方便，用讀卡機器刷一下信用卡就能付錢了。
examples.pinyin: Shuākǎ mǎi dōngxī hěn fāngbiàn, yòng dúkǎ jīqì shuā yīxià xìnyòngkǎ jiù néng fù qián le.
examples.english: Using a credit card to buy things is very convenient; with a card reader, you just swipe the credit card once and you can pay.

examples.chinese: 信用卡的正面和背面都有一組號碼，在線上刷卡時用得到。
examples.pinyin: Xìnyòngkǎ de zhèngmiàn hé bèimiàn dōu yǒu yī zǔ hàomǎ, zài xiànshàng shuākǎ shí yòng de dào.
examples.english: Both the front side and the back of a credit card have a set of numbers; they are used when swiping the card online.

examples.chinese: 刷卡購物時，店員會先確認你的簽名是不是和信用卡上的相同。
examples.pinyin: Shuākǎ gòuwù shí, diànyuán huì xiān quèrèn nǐ de qiānmíng shì bùshì hé xìnyòngkǎ shàng de xiāngtóng.
examples.english: When paying by credit card, the clerk will first confirm whether your signature is the same as the one on the credit card.

examples.chinese: 這個山區種了許多茶樹，到了收穫季節，就會有一群採茶姑娘上山採茶。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shānqū zhòng le xǔduō cháshù, dào le shōuhuò jìjié, jiù huì yǒu yī qún cǎi chá gūniang shàngshān cǎi chá.
examples.english: Many tea trees are planted in this mountainous area; when the harvest season comes, a group of tea-picking girls will go up the mountain to pick tea.

examples.chinese: 要是你想建議公司採購新設備，可以上網填採購單。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ xiǎng jiànyì gōngsī cǎigòu xīn shèbèi, kěyǐ shàngwǎng tián cǎigòu dān.
examples.english: If you want to suggest that the company purchase new equipment, you can fill out a purchase form online.

examples.chinese: 經理這次願意採用新員工的建議，讓我們都嚇了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ zhè cì yuànyì cǎiyòng xīn yuángōng de jiànyì, ràng wǒmen dōu xià le yí tiào.
examples.english: The manager is willing to adopt the new employee's suggestion this time, which gave us all a start.

examples.chinese: 我採花的時候被刺了一下，不過還好不太痛。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cǎi huā de shíhou bèi cì le yīxià, bùguò hái hǎo bù tài tòng.
examples.english: When I was picking flowers, I got pricked once, but fortunately it didn't hurt too much.

examples.chinese: 企業為了錄用合適的人才，而採用各式各樣的方式。
examples.pinyin: Qǐyè wèile lùyòng héshì de réncái, ér cǎiyòng gè shì gè yàng de fāngshì.
examples.english: Enterprises adopt various methods in order to hire suitable talent.

examples.chinese: 這次畢業典禮，學校打算採用空拍的方式來拍紀念影片。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì bìyè diǎnlǐ, xuéxiào dǎsuàn cǎiyòng kōngpāi de fāngshì lái pāi jìniàn yǐngpiàn.
examples.english: For this graduation ceremony, the school plans to use aerial photography to shoot a commemorative video.

examples.chinese: 自從採用專家提供的方法後，茶葉的產量已增加百分之五十。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng cǎiyòng zhuānjiā tígōng de fāngfǎ hòu, cháyè de chǎnliàng yǐ zēngjiā bǎifēnzhī wǔshí.
examples.english: Since adopting the method provided by experts, the production output of tea leaves has increased by 50 percent.

examples.chinese: 這一盤棋你下得真好，你一定花了很多工夫研究。
examples.pinyin: Zhè yì pán qí nǐ xià de zhēn hǎo, nǐ yídìng huā le hěn duō gōngfu yánjiū.
examples.english: You played this game of chess really well; you must have spent a lot of effort studying.

examples.chinese: 中國人看傳統戲劇時都喜歡準備一盤瓜子，邊吃邊欣賞。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguórén kàn chuántǒng xìjù shí dōu xǐhuān zhǔnbèi yī pán guāzǐ, biān chī biān xīnshǎng.
examples.english: When Chinese people watch traditional opera, they all like to prepare a plate of melon seeds and enjoy them while watching.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的服務生很厲害，一隻手能端好幾個盤子。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de fúwùshēng hěn lìhài, yī zhī shǒu néng duān hǎo jǐ gè pánzi.
examples.english: The waiter at that restaurant is very impressive; he can hold several plates level with one hand.

examples.chinese: 打破你們的碗盤是我的錯，我會對自己的行為負責，付你們這個費用。
examples.pinyin: Dǎpò nǐmen de wǎnpán shì wǒ de cuò, wǒ huì duì zìjǐ de xíngwéi fùzé, fù nǐmen zhège fèiyòng.
examples.english: Breaking your dishes was my fault; I will take responsibility for my behavior and pay you this fee.

examples.chinese: 要是你覺得這盤菜的味道太淡了，可以加一點醬料。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ juéde zhè pán cài de wèidào tài dàn le, kěyǐ jiā yìdiǎn jiàngliào.
examples.english: If you feel this dish's flavor is too light, you can add a little sauce.

examples.chinese: 在這家餐廳吃飯，要是滿兩千元，老闆就免費招待一盤炒青菜。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng chīfàn, yàoshi mǎn liǎngqiān yuán, lǎobǎn jiù miǎnfèi zhāodài yī pán chǎo qīngcài.
examples.english: If you spend at least two thousand dollars at this restaurant, the owner will treat you to a free plate of stir-fried greens.

examples.chinese: 你說你昨天吃了五盤芒果冰，太誇張了吧！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō nǐ zuótiān chīle wǔ pán mángguǒ bīng, tài kuāzhāng le ba!
examples.english: You say you ate five plates of mango shaved ice yesterday—that's too exaggerated!

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"在這家餐廳吃飯，只要滿兩千塊，就送一盤水果。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"那個杯子裡裝滿了水。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng chīfàn, zhǐyào mǎn liǎngqiān kuài, jiù sòng yī pán shuǐguǒ. Nàge bēizi lǐ zhuāng mǎn le shuǐ.
examples.english: At this restaurant, as long as you reach 2,000 dollars, they give you a plate of fruit. That cup is full of water.

examples.chinese: 這幾盤菜都是我媽媽做的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ pán cài dōu shì wǒ māma zuò de.
examples.english: These few plates of dishes are all made by my mom.

examples.chinese: 這幾盤菜都是我媽媽做的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ pán cài dōu shì wǒ māma zuò de.
examples.english: These few plates of dishes are all made by my mom.

examples.chinese: A:我們要點幾盤菜？ B:今天是你的生日，我們多點幾盤吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒmen yào diǎn jǐ pán cài? B: Jīntiān shì nǐ de shēngrì, wǒmen duō diǎn jǐ pán ba.
examples.english: A: How many dishes shall we order? B: Today is your birthday; let's order a few more dishes.

examples.chinese: 這部電腦的鍵盤有幾個鍵壞了，我得找人修理它。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànnǎo de jiànpán yǒu jǐ ge jiàn huài le, wǒ děi zhǎo rén xiūlǐ tā.
examples.english: Several keys on this computer's keyboard are broken; I need to find someone to repair it.

examples.chinese: 那家公司的鍵盤常出問題，我再傻也不會跟他們購買。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngsī de jiànpán cháng chū wèntí, wǒ zài shǎ yě bú huì gēn tāmen gòumǎi.
examples.english: That company's keyboards often have problems; no matter how foolish I am, I wouldn't buy from them.

examples.chinese: 我們到小張家時，他端了一盤切好的水果來招待我們。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dào Xiǎo Zhāng jiā shí, tā duān le yī pán qiē hǎo de shuǐguǒ lái zhāodài wǒmen.
examples.english: When we arrived at Little Zhang's house, he brought out a plate of cut fruit to treat us.

items.wordHook: a 般(sort) tray of 皿(dish) plates rests on the table → one wide 盤(plate).

examples.chinese: 林老師是我的高中導師，在學習上也是影響我最深的人。
examples.pinyin: Lín lǎoshī shì wǒ de gāozhōng dǎoshī, zài xuéxí shàng yěshì yǐngxiǎng wǒ zuì shēn de rén.
examples.english: Teacher Lin was my high school homeroom teacher and is also the person who has influenced me most in my studies.

examples.chinese: 對我來說，食物營養不營養無所謂，只要好吃就行了。
examples.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, shíwù yíngyǎng bù yíngyǎng wúsuǒwèi, zhǐyào hǎochī jiù xíng le.
examples.english: To me, whether food is nutritious or not doesn't matter; as long as it's tasty, that's fine.

examples.chinese: 要是你擔心營養不夠的話，吃點兒維他命對身體健康會有幫助的。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ dānxīn yíngyǎng bù gòu de huà, chī diǎnr wéitāmìng duì shēntǐ jiànkāng huì yǒu bāngzhù de.
examples.english: If you're worried about not getting enough nutrition, taking some vitamins will help your health.

examples.chinese: 奶奶把變黃的蔬菜葉子埋在地裡，讓它變成草地的營養。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai bǎ biàn huáng de shūcài yèzi mái zài dì lǐ, ràng tā biànchéng cǎodì de yíngyǎng.
examples.english: Grandma buried the yellowed vegetable leaves in the ground, letting them become nutrition for the lawn.

examples.chinese: 要想擁有好身材，除了注意營養，還得多運動。
examples.pinyin: Yào xiǎng yōngyǒu hǎo shēncái, chúle zhùyì yíngyǎng, hái děi duō yùndòng.
examples.english: If you want to have a good figure, besides paying attention to nutrition, you also need to exercise more.

examples.chinese: 有的人一喝牛奶就拉肚子，可能是因為身體吸收不料牛奶的營養。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu de rén yì hē niúnǎi jiù lādùzi, kěnéng shì yīnwèi shēntǐ xīshōu bù liǎo niúnǎi de yíngyǎng.
examples.english: Some people get diarrhea as soon as they drink milk; it may be because their body cannot absorb the nutrition in milk.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳的菜不僅平價，還很營養，常常中午十二點前舉客滿了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài bùjǐn píngjià, hái hěn yíngyǎng, chángcháng zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn qián jiù kèmǎn le.
examples.english: This restaurant's dishes are not only affordable but also very nutritious; it is often full before 12 noon.

examples.chinese: 剩下的飯菜加熱太多次，就沒什麼營養了，最好每餐都吃光。
examples.pinyin: Shèngxià de fàncài jiārè tài duō cì, jiù méi shénme yíngyǎng le, zuìhǎo měi cān dōu chī guāng.
examples.english: If leftover food is heated too many times, it loses its nutrition; it's best to finish it all at each meal.

examples.chinese: 為了家人的健康，媽媽每天都早起準備營養豐富的早餐，讓我們一天的開始就很有精神。
examples.pinyin: Wèile jiārén de jiànkāng, māma měitiān dōu zǎoqǐ zhǔnbèi yíngyǎng fēngfù de zǎocān, ràng wǒmen yì tiān de kāishǐ jiù hěn yǒu jīngshén.
examples.english: For the family's health, Mom gets up early every day to prepare a nutritious breakfast, so that we start the day full of energy.

examples.chinese: 蛋黃月餅的營養豐富，可是不能多吃，不然很容易發胖。
examples.pinyin: Dànhuáng yuèbǐng de yíngyǎng fēngfù, kěshì bùnéng duō chī, bùrán hěn róngyì fāpàng.
examples.english: Egg yolk mooncakes are rich in nutrition, but you can't eat too many, otherwise you'll easily gain weight.

examples.chinese: 學校餐廳提供各式各樣的營養食品，供學生挑選。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào cāntīng tígōng gè shì gè yàng de yíngyǎng shípǐn, gōng xuéshēng tiāoxuǎn.
examples.english: The school cafeteria provides a variety of nutritious foods for students to choose from.

examples.chinese: 運動選手在參加比賽前，補充營養的飲食很重要。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòng xuǎnshǒu zài cānjiā bǐsài qián, bǔchōng yíngyǎng de yǐnshí hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: Before athletes participate in a competition, a diet that replenishes nutrition is very important.

examples.chinese: 當你大學畢業，不再升學時，就得考慮就業問題了。
examples.pinyin: Dāng nǐ dàxué bìyè, bù zài shēngxué shí, jiù děi kǎolǜ jiùyè wèntí le.
examples.english: When you graduate from university and are no longer pursuing further studies, you then have to consider the issue of employment.

examples.chinese: 華語書籍陳列在書架的左邊，如有興趣可隨意翻翻。
examples.pinyin: Huáyǔ shūjí chénliè zài shūjià de zuǒbiān, rú yǒu xìngqù kě suíyì fānfān.
examples.english: Chinese-language books are displayed on the left side of the bookshelf; if interested, you may browse freely.

examples.chinese: 這一屆的學生絕大部分都在畢業以前找到了工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè yī jiè de xuéshēng jué dà bùfèn dōu zài bìyè yǐqián zhǎodào le gōngzuò.
examples.english: The vast majority of this year's graduating class found jobs before graduation.

items.wordHook: a 彳(step) takes the lead while 从(follow) trails a 龰(foot) → the road 從(from) home.
Combining 文(culture) and 字(character): 文字 means writing.
浴(bathe) + 室(room) → a room for bathing, the bathroom.
A tiny crawling 虫(insect) whose name sounds just like a galloping 馬(horse) is an industrious 螞(ant).
a 言(speech) from 吾(me) fills the air, word after word: 語(words).
足(foot) + 球(ball) → the foot ball: 足球(soccer; football).
A room for doing public affairs: 辦(do) + 公(public) + 室(room) = office.
